scope: Training-only temporal head fine-tuning after resource dispatch optimization; frozen before new model scores. No reserved testing loaded.
model_choice: Quiet-bound8bit export frozen by numeric/fidelity only, not detector scores.6bit grid failed prespecifiedcosinegate and is rejected.
frontend: Exact512FFT window and257x32melmatrix,160samplehop,80dBfloor per1760sample block;8newframes per1280PCM/80ms. Native host versus source graph verified training-only.
data: Existing source/voice partitions; training+validation only.2normal-speed TTS variants: original quiet and room/gain/noise augmentation. Same human/environment source partitions, only training for fitting; no reserved testing read.
labels: Positive whole-phrase end uses existing synthesis/RMS metadata. Random head end .03.. .32seconds after label; reportendpointuncertainty. Negatives sample across all source windows.
head: Conv32(5,96)/BN/ReLU -> Conv32(5,1)/BN/ReLU -> GlobalMaxPool -> Dropout(.15) -> Dense1 sigmoid; BN folds into Conv
selection: Select highest macro recall on validation at <=.5 continuous false events/hour, tie lower FAR then lower confusing rate then earlier checkpoint. Retain strict/near-phrase diagnostics; freeze before existing paired/long regression. No reserved scores, no acceptance without physical/resource/voice-chain tests.

event_policy.selection_order: Select highest macro recall on validation at <=.5 continuous false events/hour, tie lower FAR then lower confusing rate then earlier checkpoint. Retain strict/near-phrase diagnostics; freeze before existing paired/long regression. No reserved scores, no acceptance without physical/resource/voice-chain tests.

upstream_match_scope: Same DNN topology and LayerNorm epsilon, adapted to Keras, with v1 fixed training recipe rather than claiming identical upstream optimization.

comparison.control: Continue frozen temporal head with original environmental training views
comparison.screen: Same initialization/seed/recipe with completed screened Qwen training views added
comparison.limits: Adding an engine changes subsequent sampler draws. This is not a claim of identical minibatches.

consistency_screen.scope: Imperfect training-only ablation; neither recognizer is pronunciation truth
consistency_screen.positive_keep: Canonical phoneme pattern OR canonical unprompted ASR transcript
consistency_screen.negative_keep: Neither canonical phoneme pattern nor canonical ASR transcript
consistency_screen.phoneme_rule: Within first12greedy phones: optional h, eɪ/eː/e/ɛ, n, ɪ/i/iː, k, s; same existing screen rule

phoneme_model_identity.use: Independent phoneme consistency diagnostic only; no wake model acceptance

consistency_screen.asr: Existing pinned faster-whisper tiny.en, English, beam3, no VAD/context/expected-text prompt
consistency_screen.limits: May exclude valid accents or keep ambiguous synthesis; select only by unchanged validation and compare development metrics before any new test acceptance.
